newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates end down on ginners offload.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates end down on ginners offload.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates ended down on Tuesday as ginners, with some two million 375-lb bales of unsold cotton, tried to offload their stocks in the domestic market, dealers said.

The offloading by the ginners and low buying interest of spinners pulled the prices down, broker Mustafa Hussain at the private Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said. The spinners were likely to enter the market after the Moslem Eid al-Fitr festival next month.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted between 2,250 and 2,275 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), he said.
Exporters had shipped 15,720 375-lb bales between September 1 and December 31, 1996 compared to 541,722 in the year-ago period, a KCA official said.
